contract.intent: Tree store (S1) — reads/writes legs, nodes, events, artifacts per journey-format-spec v8; builds the in-memory tree; enforces schema, append-only, immutability, leg gate; owns the single appendEvent() write function (architecture LB-3 — the only writer); exposes derived views (status/resolution/branch) for shared readers. Absorbs scripts/resolve.mjs + validate.mjs as the store seed.
acceptanceCriteria: appendEvent() is the ONLY write path (LB-3): schema validated against the vocab registry, append-only, no reorder/delete/rewrite
In-memory tree built from files at startup; derived views: leg status from tasks (v8 §12), resolution current(name), branch walk
Schema enforcement: unknown fields/types rejected (vocab registry); immutable node.json never rewritten
Leg gate: no leg N+1 work before all leg N tasks done (derived aggregate, v8 §13)
Unit tests (vitest) covering the store-relevant F-AC1..F-AC17
